subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: For Anthropic QuickStart first runs, should OpenClaw keep the Opus default with an explicit paid-credit warning/preflight, switch the default to a lower-cost Anthropic model, or document the current Opus behavior as intentional?
rationale: The code fix is small, but the right behavior changes provider/model default policy and first-run UX for paid hosted models, which is maintainer product direction rather than a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Add warning/preflight before hatch
options.body: Keep the current Anthropic model selection but require onboarding to warn or check billing readiness before launching the first Terminal chat and to show a non-install-failure recovery message on billing errors.

options.title: Switch Anthropic QuickStart default
options.body: Change the default seeded model for Anthropic API-key/setup-token onboarding to a lower-cost model and update tests/docs around the new default.

options.title: Document current behavior
options.body: Leave Opus as the intentional first-run default and document that Anthropic API-key users need billing credits before the first chat.

recommendation.title: Add warning/preflight before hatch
recommendation.body: Keep the current Anthropic model selection but require onboarding to warn or check billing readiness before launching the first Terminal chat and to show a non-install-failure recovery message on billing errors.

likelyOwner.reason: The product choice is closest to the Anthropic default-policy history introduced in commit 628b454eff6e.
